source.selection: Nested Go-only frames ordered by SHA256(memory-profile-20261018: + path); no selection on Entmoot output

measurement.allocator: System with atomic size counters and 4/8 MiB allocation/reallocation/drop calibration
measurement.method: Counting GlobalAlloc delegates unchanged to System; records requested live/peak/cumulative Rust allocations at ownership boundaries. Parent measurements reuse evals.harness.measurement.command.
measurement.calibration: Each process independently verifies 4 MiB zeroed allocation, growth to 8 MiB, and exact return after drop.
limits: Rust allocator-requested live bytes exclude C/native allocations, stacks, allocator metadata, fragmentation and mapped pages.
Allocation atomics add overhead; this is attribution, not release latency qualification.
Prepare mode intentionally returns an iterator error at exhaustion, before the publication transaction; fresh DB schema setup still occurs.
Sampled fixtures have incomplete package context; no dispatch or runtime semantic claim.
Destructive field release is ordered attribution, not an additive canonical retained-size analysis.
Small bookkeeping allocations are included at checkpoints; use rounded ownership deltas.
Full graph reload is not original-build peak and does not establish a successful publication.
No release latency improvement, native semantic completeness or fixed memory bound is claimed.

publisher_512.scope: Production batch preparation before complete-reference validation or publication transaction; deliberate exhaustion error releases collected state.

repeat_128.conclusion: Smaller residual growth reproduced in graph construction without the publisher. The isolated observation/scan controls do not reproduce sustained growth. Leak versus deferred/runtime retention remains unresolved.

recommended_order.action: Evaluate compact storage for large optional node payloads and excessive vector capacity; preserve serialized shape, IDs and behavior with independent roundtrip/parity controls.
Remove publication-wide retention of typed batches plus cloned serialized rows; preserve immutable collisions, forward-reference validation, no-change behavior, rollback and atomic publication.
Reduce simultaneous ownership of parsed records, syntax/call cache fragments and graph copies; retain source fences, corruption checks and negative-lookup invalidation.
Use allocation-stack profiling to attribute the smaller repeated-build residual; do not call the path leak-free.
Remeasure initial publication after representation/retention changes; introduce additional worker orchestration only for a measured remaining bottleneck.
